Subject: Post-call: technical deep dive (ML/infra) - next steps

Hi Alex — thanks again for the conversation today. Quick recap and suggested next steps after our discovery: 

- Outcome: Acme wants a deep technical discussion between your ML team and our infra/serving engineers to validate latency/cost assumptions and integration points.
- Goal for the deep dive: confirm model serving architecture, data flow, auth/keys, and a small pilot scope.
- Suggested length: 60–90 minutes (recommend 90 if you want to cover both model and infra topics).

Can you confirm the right attendees from your side (ML lead + infra/platform + procurement for contracting questions)? If so, we can propose specific times — below are a couple of windows that work for our ML/infra engineers:

- Wed Aug 11: 10:00–11:30 AM PT / 1:00–2:30 PM ET
- Thu Aug 12: 8:30–10:00 AM PT / 11:30–1:00 PM ET

If neither works, happy to send a Calendly link. I’ve attached a short Redwood Platform Overview and a one-page mutual action plan to frame the session (Redwood-Platform-Overview.pdf, Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx).

Proposed agenda (we can adjust):
1) 5 min - intros and goals
2) 20 min - current ML architecture & constraints (Acme)
3) 30 min - Redwood serving architecture, latency/cost profiles, quantization/hosting options
4) 20 min - integration points, data paths, auth, telemetry
5) 15 min - pilot scope, next steps, and contracting touchpoints

Let me know who will join and which of the times above work.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0198
